Coverage Directory FAQ

Frequently asked questions about personal and commercial insurance lines.

We provide personal insurance (homeowners, auto, life, health, umbrella) and commercial insurance (business owner policies, general liability, commercial property, workers' compensation, commercial auto, surety bonds, and group employee benefits).
Unlike captive agencies that only sell products from a single company, an independent agency like Surebound works with multiple insurance carriers to compare options and find the best coverage and price for your situation.
